name: v_ForexPriceHistory_JSON
sql:
/*===============================================================
  View:   v_ForexPriceHistory_JSON
  Purpose: One JSON document per timestamp with bid/ask per pair
           from forex_price_history where the price string is
           formatted  key , value , key , value …
===============================================================*/
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW "v_ForexPriceHistory_JSON" AS
WITH raw AS (      -- 1) split + ordinal
        SELECT  f.current_datetime,
                s.value                           AS token,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                    PARTITION BY f.current_datetime
                    ORDER BY (SELECT 1)
                )                                 AS seq
        FROM  forex_price_history AS f
        CROSS JOIN LATERAL tsql_compat.string_split(f.current_prices, ',') AS s
),
pairs AS (         -- 2) key token + next token (its numeric value)
        SELECT  r1.current_datetime,
                r1.token AS "key_token",
                r2.token AS "val_token"
        FROM   raw r1
        LEFT  JOIN raw r2
               ON  r2.current_datetime = r1.current_datetime
               AND r2.seq              = r1.seq + 1
        WHERE  r1.seq % 2 = 1
),
parsed AS (        -- 3) product / side / numeric price
        SELECT  current_datetime,
                LEFT(key_token, tsql_compat.charindex('_',key_token)-1) AS "product",
                SUBSTRING(key_token AS "side",
                                     tsql_compat.charindex('_',key_token)+1,
                                     LENGTH(key_token)),
                tsql_compat.try_convert_numeric(val_token) AS "price"
        FROM   pairs
        WHERE  tsql_compat.charindex('_', key_token) > 0
          AND  tsql_compat.try_convert_numeric(val_token) IS NOT NULL
),
tidy AS (          -- 4) pivot bid & ask onto one line
        SELECT  current_datetime,
                product,
                bid = MAX(CASE WHEN side='bid' THEN price END),
                ask = MAX(CASE WHEN side='ask' THEN price END)
        FROM   parsed
        GROUP BY current_datetime, product
),
jfrag AS (         -- 5) one JSON fragment per product
        SELECT  current_datetime,
                json_piece =
          ',"' || product || '":{' || CASE WHEN bid IS NOT NULL
                   THEN '"bid":' || LTRIM(STR(bid,18,6)) END +
              CASE WHEN bid IS NOT NULL AND ask IS NOT NULL
                   THEN ',' END +
              CASE WHEN ask IS NOT NULL
                   THEN '"ask":' || LTRIM(STR(ask,18,6)) END || '}'
        FROM   tidy
        WHERE  bid IS NOT NULL OR ask IS NOT NULL
)
/* 6) assemble full JSON per timestamp */
SELECT
    '{ "current_datetime":"' || CONVERT(varchar(33), current_datetime, 127) || '"' || STUFF((
                SELECT jf.json_piece
                FROM   jfrag jf
                WHERE  jf.current_datetime = j.current_datetime
                FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE
             ).value('.','nvarchar(max)'), 1, 0, '') || ' }' AS json_out
FROM jfrag j
GROUP BY current_datetime;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW "vw_000_forex_price_latest" AS

WITH exploded AS
(
    SELECT
        vp.current_datetime,
        CAST(
            '<x>' || REPLACE(vp.current_prices, ',', '</x><x>') || '</x>'
            AS XML
        ) AS xml_prices
    FROM vw_000_forex_prices AS vp
),
toks AS
(
    SELECT
        current_datetime,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY current_datetime
            ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)
        ) AS rn,
        x.value('.', 'nvarchar(100)') AS token
    FROM exploded
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL xml_prices.nodes('/x') AS T(x)
),
paired AS
(
    SELECT
        current_datetime,
        key_name  = MAX(CASE WHEN rn % 2 = 1 THEN token END),
        key_value = MAX(CASE WHEN rn % 2 = 0 THEN tsql_compat.try_convert_numeric(token) END)
    FROM toks
    GROUP BY current_datetime, (rn + 1) / 2
),
maxdt AS
(
    -- find the latest timestamp
    SELECT MAX(current_datetime) AS current_datetime
    FROM paired
),
latest AS
(
    -- grab every key/value row at that latest timestamp
    SELECT p.*
    FROM paired AS p
    JOIN maxdt    AS m
      ON p.current_datetime = m.current_datetime
)

SELECT
    l.current_datetime,

    gbp_bid       = MAX(CASE WHEN key_name = 'gbp_bid'       THEN key_value END),

WITH src AS (SELECT SnapshotID, SnapshotTimestamp, Product, PositiveBuyOpen, PositiveSellOpen, - (1 * PositiveSellOpen) AS PositiveSellOpen_val, PositiveBuyClosed, PositiveSellClosed, BlockLatestPrice, signal, previous_signal,

    SELECT SnapshotID, SnapshotTimestamp, Product, PositiveBuyOpen, PositiveSellOpen, PositiveSellOpen_val, PositiveBuyClosed, PositiveSellClosed, BlockLatestPrice, signal, previous_signal, 
                      CASE WHEN signal <> COALESCE(previous_signal, '') AND signal IS NOT NULL THEN signal ELSE NULL END AS tradepoint, PositiveBuyClosedSum, PositiveSellClosedSum, PositiveBuyOpenSum, PositiveSellOpenSum, 
                      CAST((CASE WHEN PositiveSellOpen = 0 THEN PositiveBuyOpen ELSE PositiveBuyOpen / NULLIF (PositiveSellOpen, 0) END) 
                      + (CASE WHEN PositiveBuyOpen = 0 THEN PositiveSellOpen_val ELSE PositiveSellOpen_val / NULLIF (PositiveBuyOpen, 0) END) AS INT) AS BuySellIndex, TotalBuyClosed, TotalSellClosed

name: vw_002_pos_buy_sell_count_gbp_tradepoint_signal

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW "vw_002_pos_buy_sell_count_gbp_tradepoint_signal" AS
SELECT 
    SnapshotID,
    SnapshotTimestamp,
    Product,
    PositiveBuyOpen,
    PositiveSellOpen,
    PositiveSellOpen_val,
    PositiveBuyClosed,
    PositiveSellClosed,
    BlockLatestPrice,
	"TotalBuyClosed","TotalSellClosed",
    PositiveBuyClosedSum,
    PositiveSellClosedSum,
    PositiveBuyOpenSum,
    PositiveSellOpenSum,
    /* new ratio columns: cast to int and handle division by zero */
    CAST(PositiveBuyOpenSum / NULLIF(PositiveSellOpenSum, 0) AS INT) AS PositiveSumBuyOverSell,
    CAST(PositiveSellOpenSum / NULLIF(PositiveBuyOpenSum, 0) AS INT) AS PositiveSumSellOverBuy,
    BuySellIndex,
    /* enhanced tradezone column with NoBuyTrade and NoSellTrade for intermediate BSI ranges */
    CASE 
        -- signal 'buy' when BSI exceeds dynamic max or strong buy imbalance
        WHEN BuySellIndex > (SELECT config_value FROM config WHERE config_name = 'gbp_BuySellIndex_max') 
             OR (PositiveBuyOpen > PositiveSellOpen 
                 AND PositiveSellOpen < (SELECT config_value FROM config WHERE config_name = 'gbp_tradezone_limit')) 
        THEN 'buy'
        -- signal 'NoBuyTrade' when BSI is positive but below buy threshold
        WHEN BuySellIndex > 0 
             AND BuySellIndex < (SELECT config_value FROM config WHERE config_name = 'gbp_BuySellIndex_max') 
        THEN 'NoBuyTrade'
        -- signal 'NoSellTrade' when BSI is negative but above sell threshold
        WHEN BuySellIndex < 0 
             AND BuySellIndex > (SELECT config_value FROM config WHERE config_name = 'gbp_BuySellIndex_min') 
        THEN 'NoSellTrade'
        -- signal 'sell' when BSI below dynamic min or strong sell imbalance
        WHEN BuySellIndex < (SELECT config_value FROM config WHERE config_name = 'gbp_BuySellIndex_min') 
             OR (PositiveSellOpen > PositiveBuyOpen 
                 AND PositiveBuyOpen < (SELECT config_value FROM config WHERE config_name = 'gbp_tradezone_limit')) 
        THEN 'sell'
        ELSE NULL 
    END AS tradezone,
    /* existing tradepoint logic */
    CASE 
        -- signal a “buy” when BSI just crossed above the dynamic max limit
        WHEN BuySellIndex > (SELECT config_value FROM config WHERE config_name = 'gbp_BuySellIndex_max') 
             AND LAG(BuySellIndex) OVER (PARTITION BY Product ORDER BY SnapshotTimestamp, SnapshotID) 
                 <= (SELECT config_value FROM config WHERE config_name = 'gbp_BuySellIndex_max') 
        THEN 'buy'
        -- signal a “sell” when BSI just crossed below the dynamic min limit
        WHEN BuySellIndex < (SELECT config_value FROM config WHERE config_name = 'gbp_BuySellIndex_min') 
             AND LAG(BuySellIndex) OVER (PARTITION BY Product ORDER BY SnapshotTimestamp, SnapshotID) 
                 >= (SELECT config_value FROM config WHERE config_name = 'gbp_BuySellIndex_min') 
        THEN 'sell'
        ELSE NULL 
    END AS tradepoint
FROM vw_002_pos_buy_sell_count_gbp_tradepoint;

name: vw_101_PositiveOpen_WithRunningTotals
sql:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW "vw_101_PositiveOpen_WithRunningTotals" AS
/* get the reference datetime */
WITH cfg AS (
    SELECT CAST(config_value AS DATETIME) AS RefDate
    FROM   config
    WHERE  config_name = 'gbp_reference_datetime'
),

/* pull in raw data + running totals + BSI */
base AS (
    SELECT
        pss.SnapshotTimestamp,
        pss.SnapshotID,                 -- for LAG() in tradepoint
        pss.Product,
        pss.BlockLatestPrice,
        pss.PositiveBuyOpen,
        pss.PositiveSellOpen,

        /* running totals */
        SUM(pss.PositiveBuyOpen)  OVER (PARTITION BY pss.Product
                                        ORDER BY pss.SnapshotTimestamp
                                        ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) 
            AS PositiveBuyOpenSum,

        SUM(pss.PositiveSellOpen) OVER (PARTITION BY pss.Product
                                        ORDER BY pss.SnapshotTimestamp
                                        ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) 
            AS PositiveSellOpenSum,

        /* original BSI */
        x.BuySellIndex
    FROM product_signal_snapshot AS pss
    CROSS JOIN cfg
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT CAST(
                 (CASE WHEN pss.PositiveSellOpen = 0
                       THEN pss.PositiveBuyOpen
                       ELSE pss.PositiveBuyOpen / NULLIF(pss.PositiveSellOpen,0)
                  END)
               + (CASE WHEN pss.PositiveBuyOpen = 0
                       THEN pss.PositiveSellOpen
                       ELSE pss.PositiveSellOpen / NULLIF(pss.PositiveBuyOpen,0)
                  END)
               AS INT) AS BuySellIndex
    ) AS x
    WHERE pss.SnapshotTimestamp > cfg.RefDate
)

SELECT
    SnapshotTimestamp,
    Product,
    BlockLatestPrice,
    PositiveBuyOpen,
    PositiveSellOpen,
    PositiveBuyOpenSum,
    PositiveSellOpenSum,
    BuySellIndex,

    /* □ UPDATED tradezone: needs ≥100 gap □ */
    CASE
        WHEN PositiveBuyOpenSum - PositiveSellOpenSum >= 100 THEN 'buy'
        WHEN PositiveSellOpenSum - PositiveBuyOpenSum >= 100 THEN 'sell'
        ELSE NULL
    END AS tradezone,

    /* □ unchanged tradepoint crossing logic □ */
    CASE
        WHEN BuySellIndex >  100
          AND LAG(BuySellIndex) OVER 
              (PARTITION BY Product
               ORDER BY SnapshotTimestamp, SnapshotID) <= 100
        THEN 'buy'

        WHEN BuySellIndex < -100
          AND LAG(BuySellIndex) OVER 
              (PARTITION BY Product
               ORDER BY SnapshotTimestamp, SnapshotID) >= -100
        THEN 'sell'

        ELSE NULL
    END AS tradepoint

FROM base;

   Purpose:  Ten-minute aggregation for GBP, plus %
-------------------------------------------------------------------*/
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW "vw_104_TradeSummaryLog_10min" AS
/*===============================================================
  1)  Collapse buy/sell rows for the current day, age_label = 10
================================================================*/
WITH BaseData AS (
    SELECT
        CurrentDateTime,
        product,

        MAX(CASE WHEN signal = 'buy'  THEN Opened        END) AS Buy_Opened,
        MAX(CASE WHEN signal = 'buy'  THEN positive_open END) AS Buy_Positive_Open,
        MAX(CASE WHEN signal = 'buy'  THEN Closed        END) AS Buy_Closed,
        MAX(CASE WHEN signal = 'buy'  THEN positive      END) AS Buy_Positive_Closed,

        MAX(CASE WHEN signal = 'sell' THEN positive      ELSE NULL END) AS Sell_Positive_closed,
        MAX(current_prices) AS current_prices
    FROM TradeSummaryLog
    WHERE (age_label = 30) AND (CurrentDateTime >= CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS date))
    GROUP BY CurrentDateTime, product
    HAVING (product = 'gbp')
)
SELECT
    *,
    (Buy_Opened - Sell_Opened) AS open_diff,
    SUM(CASE WHEN (Buy_Opened - Sell_Opened) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (ORDER BY CurrentDateTime ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS positive_open_diff_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN (Buy_Opened - Sell_Opened) < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (ORDER BY CurrentDateTime ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS negative_open_diff_count
FROM BaseData

name: vw_104_TradeSummaryLog_60min
sql:
/* -------------------------------------------------------------------
   View:  vw_104_TradeSummaryLog_60min
   Purpose:  One-hour aggregation for GBP, plus %
-------------------------------------------------------------------*/
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW "vw_104_TradeSummaryLog_60min" AS
/*===============================================================
  1)  Collapse buy/sell rows for the current day, age_label = 60
================================================================*/
WITH BaseData AS (
    SELECT
        CurrentDateTime,
        product,

        MAX(CASE WHEN signal = 'buy'  THEN Opened        END) AS Buy_Opened,
        MAX(CASE WHEN signal = 'buy'  THEN positive_open END) AS Buy_Positive_Open,
        MAX(CASE WHEN signal = 'buy'  THEN Closed        END) AS Buy_Closed,
        MAX(CASE WHEN signal = 'buy'  THEN positive      END) AS Buy_Positive_Closed,

        MAX(CASE WHEN signal = 'sell' THEN Opened        END) AS Sell_Opened,
        MAX(CASE WHEN signal = 'sell' THEN positive_open END) AS Sell_Positive_Open,
        MAX(CASE WHEN signal = 'sell' THEN Closed        END) AS Sell_Closed,
        MAX(CASE WHEN signal = 'sell' THEN positive      END) AS Sell_Positive_Closed,

        MAX(current_prices) AS Current_Price
    FROM TradeSummaryLog WITH (READUNCOMMITTED)
    WHERE age_label = 60
      AND product     = 'gbp'                          -- hard-wired for now
      AND CurrentDateTime >= CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS date)   -- “today”
    GROUP BY CurrentDateTime, product
),
/*===============================================================
  2)  Derived columns that rely only on BaseData
================================================================*/
Calc AS (
    SELECT
        CurrentDateTime,
        product,
        Buy_Opened,
        Buy_Positive_Open,
        Buy_Closed,
        Buy_Positive_Closed,
        Sell_Opened,
        Sell_Positive_Open,
        Sell_Closed,
        Sell_Positive_Closed,
        Current_Price,

        /* difference between sides */
        Buy_Opened - Sell_Opened AS open_diff,

        /* % positive opens – protect against div/0 */
        CASE WHEN Buy_Opened  > 0
             THEN 100.0 * Buy_Positive_Open  / Buy_Opened
        END AS buy_percent,

        CASE WHEN Sell_Opened > 0
             THEN 100.0 * Sell_Positive_Open / Sell_Opened
        END AS sell_percent
    FROM BaseData
)
/*===============================================================
  3)  Final projection + running counters
================================================================*/
SELECT
    CurrentDateTime,
    product,

    Buy_Opened,
    Buy_Positive_Open,
    Buy_Closed,
    Buy_Positive_Closed,
    Sell_Opened,
    Sell_Positive_Open,
    Sell_Closed,
    Sell_Positive_Closed,
    Current_Price,

    open_diff,
    buy_percent,
    sell_percent,

    /* cumulative tallies for open-diff */
    SUM(CASE WHEN open_diff > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        OVER (ORDER BY CurrentDateTime
              ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS positive_open_diff_count,

    SUM(CASE WHEN open_diff < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        OVER (ORDER BY CurrentDateTime
              ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS negative_open_diff_count,

    /* cumulative tallies for buy/sell % thresholds */
    SUM(CASE WHEN buy_percent  > 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        OVER (ORDER BY CurrentDateTime
              ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS buy_60,

    SUM(CASE WHEN sell_percent > 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        OVER (ORDER BY CurrentDateTime
              ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS sell_60,

    SUM(CASE WHEN buy_percent  > 70 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        OVER (ORDER BY CurrentDateTime
              ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS buy_70,

    SUM(CASE WHEN sell_percent > 70 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        OVER (ORDER BY CurrentDateTime
              ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS sell_70,

    SUM(CASE WHEN buy_percent  > 80 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        OVER (ORDER BY CurrentDateTime
              ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS buy_80,

    SUM(CASE WHEN sell_percent > 80 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        OVER (ORDER BY CurrentDateTime
              ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS sell_80,

    SUM(CASE WHEN buy_percent  > 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        OVER (ORDER BY CurrentDateTime
              ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS buy_90,

    SUM(CASE WHEN sell_percent > 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        OVER (ORDER BY CurrentDateTime
              ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS sell_90
FROM Calc;

-- Modified view to include FX midprice + target_profit/target_loss aggregates
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW "vw_106_ModelPerformance_actual" AS
SELECT 
    c.model, 
    c.signal, 
    c.product,
    CAST(c.last_update AS DATE) AS last_update,
    COUNT(*) AS total_trade_count, 
    SUM(c.actual_net) AS total_return, 
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN c.actual_net > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS profitable_percent,
    AVG(CASE WHEN c.actual_net > 0 THEN c.entry_price END)  AS avg_profitable_entry_price,
    AVG(CASE WHEN c.actual_net > 0 THEN c.latest_price END) AS avg_profitable_latest_price,

    -- NEW: aggregate targets (group-safe)
    AVG(c.target_profit) AS avg_target_profit,
    AVG(c.target_loss)   AS avg_target_loss,

    -- FX mid
    (fq.bid + fq.ask) / 2.0 AS fx_midprice
FROM vwCombined_trades_closed AS c
JOIN fx_quotes AS fq
    ON c.product = fq.code
GROUP BY 
    c.model, 
    c.signal, 
    c.product, 
    CAST(c.last_update AS DATE),
    fq.bid,
    fq.ask
HAVING 
    SUM(c.actual_net) >= 0
    AND ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN c.actual_net > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) = 100;

               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                   PARTITION BY t.trade_guid
                   ORDER BY t.trade_time DESC, t.trade_id DESC
               ) AS rn
        FROM tbl_rt_trades AS t
        WHERE t.trade_status = 'open'
    ) d
    WHERE d.rn = 1
),
ClosedLatest AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT t.*,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                   PARTITION BY t.trade_guid
                   ORDER BY t.trade_time DESC, t.trade_id DESC
               ) AS rn
        FROM tbl_rt_trades AS t
        WHERE t.trade_status = 'closed'
    ) d
    WHERE d.rn = 1
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(o.trade_reason, c.trade_reason) AS trade_reason,
    COALESCE(o.trade_guid, c.trade_guid)     AS trade_guid,
    COALESCE(o.product, c.product)           AS product,
    COALESCE(o.product_type, c.product_type) AS product_type,
    COALESCE(o.flip_trade, c.flip_trade)     AS flip_trade,

    -- open
    o.trade_id                               AS open_trade_id,
    FORMAT(o.trade_time, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS open_time,
    o.signal                                 AS open_signal,
    o.trade_details                          AS open_details,
    o.execution_status                       AS open_execution_status,

    -- closed
    c.trade_id                               AS close_trade_id,
    FORMAT(c.trade_time, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS close_time,
    c.signal                                 AS close_signal,
    c.trade_details                          AS close_details,
    c.execution_status                       AS close_execution_status,

    CASE WHEN o.trade_time IS NOT NULL AND c.trade_time IS NOT NULL
         THEN tsql_compat.datediff(SECOND, o.trade_time, c.trade_time)
    END AS hold_seconds
FROM OpenLatest o
LEFT JOIN ClosedLatest c
  ON c.trade_guid = o.trade_guid
WHERE CAST(o.trade_time AS DATE) = CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS DATE);

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW "vw_110_Xhr_Returns_Summary" AS
WITH cfg AS (
    SELECT
        LOWER(CAST(config_value AS NVARCHAR(50))) AS "cv"
    FROM config
    WHERE config_name = N'scan_return_type'
),
period AS (
    SELECT
        TRY_CAST(config_value AS INT) AS "period_minutes"
    FROM config
    WHERE config_name = N'scan_analysis_period'
),
recent AS (
    SELECT
        c.product,
        c.signal,
        return_value =
            CASE
                WHEN (SELECT cv FROM cfg) IN (N'1', N'net_return')      THEN c.net_return
                WHEN (SELECT cv FROM cfg) IN (N'2', N'alt_net_return')  THEN c.alt_net_return
                ELSE c.net_return
            END
    FROM vwCombined_trades_closed AS c
    CROSS JOIN cfg
    CROSS JOIN period p
    WHERE c.created >= tsql_compat.dateadd(MINUTE, -p.period_minutes, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
),
filtered AS (
    SELECT product, signal, return_value
    FROM recent
    WHERE return_value > 0
),
agg AS (
    SELECT product, signal, SUM(return_value) AS sum_return
    FROM filtered
    GROUP BY product, signal
)
SELECT
    product,
    buy_sum  = COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN signal = N'buy'  THEN sum_return END), 0.0),
    sell_sum = COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN signal = N'sell' THEN sum_return END), 0.0),
    suggested_signal =
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN signal = N'buy'  THEN sum_return END), 0.0)
               > COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN signal = N'sell' THEN sum_return END), 0.0)
                THEN N'buy'
            WHEN COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN signal = N'sell' THEN sum_return END), 0.0)
               > COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN signal = N'buy'  THEN sum_return END), 0.0)
                THEN N'sell'
            ELSE N'neutral'
        END
FROM agg
GROUP BY product;

        CAST(COALESCE(c.alt_net_return, 0) AS DECIMAL(18,8))   AS alt_net_return,
        LOWER(COALESCE(c.signal, ''))                          AS signal
    FROM vwCombined_trades_closed AS c
),
Agg AS (
    SELECT
        b.last_update_minute,

        SUM(CASE WHEN b.signal IN ('sell','s') THEN b.alt_net_return ELSE 0 END) AS sell_alt_net_return
    FROM Base b
    GROUP BY b.last_update_minute
)
SELECT
    a.last_update_minute AS last_update,
    a.buy_alt_net_return,
    a.sell_alt_net_return,
    SUM(a.buy_alt_net_return)  OVER (ORDER BY a.last_update_minute ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS buy_alt_net_sum,
    SUM(a.sell_alt_net_return) OVER (ORDER BY a.last_update_minute ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS sell_alt_net_sum

        AVG(CASE WHEN b.signal IN ('sell','s') THEN b.entry_price END)            AS sell_entry_price

    GROUP BY b.last_update_minute
)
SELECT
    a.last_update_minute AS last_update,
    a.buy_alt_net_return,
    a.sell_alt_net_return,
    SUM(a.buy_alt_net_return)  OVER (ORDER BY a.last_update_minute ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cumulative_buy_alt_net_return,
    SUM(a.sell_alt_net_return) OVER (ORDER BY a.last_update_minute ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cumulative_sell_alt_net_return,

            PARTITION BY b.model, b.signal
            ORDER BY b.last_update, b.guid
            ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
        ) AS net_return_sum,

            ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
        ) AS alt_net_return_sum

    SELECT
        o.guid,
        CASE
            WHEN o.zone_name = 'red' AND o.signal = 'buy' THEN
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.product ORDER BY o.last_update, o.guid)
        END AS red_buy,
        CASE
            WHEN o.zone_name = 'red' AND o.signal = 'sell' THEN
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.product ORDER BY o.last_update, o.guid)
        END AS red_sell

base_c AS (

        c.signal,
        c.last_update,
        c.net_return,
        c.alt_net_return
    FROM vwCombined_trades_closed AS c
),
w_c AS (
    SELECT
        b.guid,

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW "vw_118_PositiveTradeCounts_ByMinute" AS
WITH MinuteBuckets AS (
    SELECT
        product,
        trade_status,
        tsql_compat.dateadd(MINUTE, tsql_compat.datediff(MINUTE, 0, last_update), 0) AS last_update_minute,
        signal,
        net_return,
        latest_price,
        last_update,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY product, trade_status,
                         tsql_compat.dateadd(MINUTE, tsql_compat.datediff(MINUTE, 0, last_update), 0)
            ORDER BY last_update DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM vw_114_Combined_trades_all_flex 
),

    SELECT
        product,
        trade_status,
        last_update_minute,
        SUM(CASE WHEN signal = 'buy'  AND net_return > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS buy_count_pos,
        SUM(CASE WHEN signal = 'sell' AND net_return > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sell_count_pos,
        MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN latest_price END) AS latest_price
    FROM MinuteBuckets
    GROUP BY
        product,
        trade_status,
        last_update_minute
)
SELECT
    product,
    trade_status,
    last_update_minute,
    buy_count_pos,
    sell_count_pos,
    SUM(buy_count_pos) OVER (PARTITION BY product, trade_status ORDER BY last_update_minute) AS cumulative_buy_count_pos,

FROM MinuteCounts;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW "vw_120_buy_sell_count_hrly_change" AS
WITH x AS (
    SELECT
        product,
        HourBucket,
        sell,
        buy,
        update_time,
        DATEPART(HOUR, HourBucket) AS HourOnly,

        -- hour-start baselines
        FIRST_VALUE(sell) OVER (
            PARTITION BY product, HourBucket
            ORDER BY update_time
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
        ) AS base_sell_for_hour,

        FIRST_VALUE(buy) OVER (
            PARTITION BY product, HourBucket
            ORDER BY update_time
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
        ) AS base_buy_for_hour
    FROM hrly_signal_perf_snapshots
    WHERE DATEPART(HOUR, HourBucket) >= DATEPART(HOUR, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)-0
    -- AND CAST(HourBucket AS date) = CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS date)
)
SELECT
    x.product,
    x.HourBucket,
    x.sell,
    x.buy,
    x.update_time,
    x.HourOnly,
    x.base_sell_for_hour,
    x.base_buy_for_hour,

    -- point-in-time changes vs hour start
    (x.buy  - x.base_buy_for_hour)  AS buy_change,
    (x.sell - x.base_sell_for_hour) AS sell_change,

    -- RUNNING averages from the start of each hour (ordered by update_time)
    AVG(CAST(x.buy  - x.base_buy_for_hour  AS decimal(18,6)))
        OVER (PARTITION BY x.product, x.HourBucket
              ORDER BY x.update_time
              ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS average_buy_change,

    AVG(CAST(x.sell - x.base_sell_for_hour AS decimal(18,6)))
        OVER (PARTITION BY x.product, x.HourBucket
              ORDER BY x.update_time
              ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS average_sell_change
FROM x;

name: vw_122_zone_counts_by_update_pivoted2

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW "vw_122_zone_counts_by_update_pivoted2" AS
WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        z.product,
        z.last_update,
        z.beyondTarget_buy, z.darkgreen_buy, z.green_buy, z.yellow_buy, z.pink_buy, z.red_buy,
        z.beyondstop_buy, z.current_price,
        z.beyondstop_sell, z.red_sell, z.pink_sell, z.yellow_sell, z.green_sell, z.darkgreen_sell,
        z.beyondTarget_sell, z.captured_on,

		/* strong combo */
		CASE 
			WHEN (z.red_buy  > 0 AND z.red_sell = 0) 
				 OR (z.red_buy > (z.red_sell * 2)) 
				THEN 'SELL'

			WHEN (z.red_sell > 0 AND z.red_buy  = 0) 
				 OR (z.red_sell > (z.red_buy * 2)) 
				THEN 'BUY'

			ELSE 'HOLD'
		END AS signal_combo,



        /* beyondTarget */
        CASE
            WHEN z.beyondTarget_buy  > 0 THEN 'BUY'
            WHEN z.beyondTarget_sell > 0 THEN 'SELL'
            ELSE 'HOLD'
        END AS signal_beyondtarget,

        /* darkgreen */
        CASE
            WHEN z.darkgreen_buy  > 0 AND z.darkgreen_sell = 0 THEN 'BUY'
            WHEN z.darkgreen_sell > 0 AND z.darkgreen_buy  = 0 THEN 'SELL'
            ELSE 'HOLD'
        END AS signal_darkgreen,

        /* beyondstop */
        CASE
            WHEN z.beyondstop_buy  > 0 AND z.beyondstop_sell > 0 THEN 'PAUSE'
            WHEN z.beyondstop_buy  > 0 THEN 'SELL'
            WHEN z.beyondstop_sell > 0 THEN 'BUY'
            ELSE 'HOLD'
        END AS signal_beyondstop,

        /* final precedence */
        CASE
            WHEN (z.beyondTarget_buy  > 0 AND z.beyondstop_sell > 0) THEN 'BUY'
            WHEN (z.beyondTarget_sell > 0 AND z.beyondstop_buy  > 0) THEN 'SELL'
            WHEN z.beyondTarget_buy  > 0 THEN 'BUY'
            WHEN z.beyondTarget_sell > 0 THEN 'SELL'
            WHEN z.darkgreen_buy  > 0 AND z.darkgreen_sell = 0 THEN 'BUY'
            WHEN z.darkgreen_sell > 0 AND z.darkgreen_buy  = 0 THEN 'SELL'
            WHEN (z.beyondstop_buy  > 0 AND z.beyondstop_sell > 0) THEN 'PAUSE'
            WHEN z.beyondstop_buy  > 0 THEN 'SELL'
            WHEN z.beyondstop_sell > 0 THEN 'BUY'
            ELSE 'HOLD'
        END AS signal_final_raw
    FROM zone_counts_minutely_log AS z
    WHERE z.last_update > CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS date)
),
ff AS (
    SELECT
        b.*,
        CASE WHEN b.signal_final_raw IN ('BUY','SELL') THEN b.signal_final_raw END AS sig_nonhold,
        -- forward-fill group PER PRODUCT (increment on each BUY/SELL)
        COUNT(CASE WHEN b.signal_final_raw IN ('BUY','SELL') THEN 1 END)
            OVER (
                PARTITION BY b.product
                ORDER BY b.last_update, b.captured_on
                ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
            ) AS grp
    FROM base AS b
)
SELECT
    ff.product,
    ff.last_update,
    ff.beyondTarget_buy, ff.darkgreen_buy, ff.green_buy, ff.yellow_buy, ff.pink_buy, ff.red_buy,
    ff.beyondstop_buy, ff.current_price,
    ff.beyondstop_sell, ff.red_sell, ff.pink_sell, ff.yellow_sell, ff.green_sell, ff.darkgreen_sell,
    ff.beyondTarget_sell, ff.captured_on,
    ff.signal_combo, ff.signal_beyondtarget, ff.signal_darkgreen, ff.signal_beyondstop,
    -- per-product forward-fill of last BUY/SELL; HOLD if none seen yet
    COALESCE(MAX(ff.sig_nonhold) OVER (PARTITION BY ff.product, ff.grp), 'HOLD') AS signal_final
FROM ff;

            WHEN z.beyondstop_sell > 0 THEN 'BUY'
            ELSE 'HOLD'
        END AS signal_beyondstop,

        /* final precedence */
        CASE
            WHEN (z.beyondTarget_buy  > 0 AND z.beyondstop_sell > 0) THEN 'BUY'
            WHEN (z.beyondTarget_sell > 0 AND z.beyondstop_buy  > 0) THEN 'SELL'
            WHEN z.beyondTarget_buy  > 0 THEN 'BUY'
            WHEN z.beyondTarget_sell > 0 THEN 'SELL'
            WHEN z.darkgreen_buy  > 0 AND z.darkgreen_sell = 0 THEN 'BUY'
            WHEN z.darkgreen_sell > 0 AND z.darkgreen_buy  = 0 THEN 'SELL'
            WHEN (z.beyondstop_buy  > 0 AND z.beyondstop_sell > 0) THEN 'PAUSE'
            WHEN z.beyondstop_buy  > 0 THEN 'SELL'
            WHEN z.beyondstop_sell > 0 THEN 'BUY'
            ELSE 'HOLD'
        END AS signal_final_raw
    FROM zone_counts_minutely_log AS z
    WHERE z.last_update > tsql_compat.dateadd(DAY,-1,CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS date))
),
ff AS (
    SELECT
        b.*,
        CASE WHEN b.signal_final_raw IN ('BUY','SELL') THEN b.signal_final_raw END AS sig_nonhold,
        -- forward-fill group PER PRODUCT (increment on each BUY/SELL)
        COUNT(CASE WHEN b.signal_final_raw IN ('BUY','SELL') THEN 1 END)
            OVER (
                PARTITION BY b.product
                ORDER BY b.last_update, b.captured_on
                ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
            ) AS grp
    FROM base AS b
)
SELECT
    ff.product,
    ff.last_update,
    ff.beyondTarget_buy, ff.darkgreen_buy, ff.green_buy, ff.yellow_buy, ff.pink_buy, ff.red_buy,
    ff.beyondstop_buy, ff.current_price,
    ff.beyondstop_sell, ff.red_sell, ff.pink_sell, ff.yellow_sell, ff.green_sell, ff.darkgreen_sell,
    ff.beyondTarget_sell, ff.captured_on,
    ff.signal_combo, ff.signal_beyondtarget, ff.signal_darkgreen, ff.signal_beyondstop,
    -- per-product forward-fill of last BUY/SELL; HOLD if none seen yet
    COALESCE(MAX(ff.sig_nonhold) OVER (PARTITION BY ff.product, ff.grp), 'HOLD') AS signal_final
FROM ff;

name: vw_123_zone_counts_with_prev

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW "vw_123_zone_counts_with_prev" AS
WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        v.product,
        v.last_update,

        /* current values */
		v.darkgreen_buy,
		v.darkgreen_sell,
		v.green_buy,
		v.green_sell,
        v.pink_buy,
        v.red_buy,
        v.beyondstop_buy,
        v.current_price,
        v.beyondstop_sell,
        v.red_sell,
        v.pink_sell,

        v.signal_combo,
        v.signal_beyondtarget,
        v.signal_darkgreen,
        v.signal_beyondstop,
        v.signal_final,

        /* previous values */
        LAG(v.darkgreen_buy)        OVER (PARTITION BY v.product ORDER BY v.last_update) AS prev_darkgreen_buy,
        LAG(v.darkgreen_sell)        OVER (PARTITION BY v.product ORDER BY v.last_update) AS prev_darkgreen_sell,
        LAG(v.pink_buy)        OVER (PARTITION BY v.product ORDER BY v.last_update) AS prev_pink_buy,
        LAG(v.red_buy)         OVER (PARTITION BY v.product ORDER BY v.last_update) AS prev_red_buy,
        LAG(v.beyondstop_buy)  OVER (PARTITION BY v.product ORDER BY v.last_update) AS prev_beyondstop_buy,
        LAG(v.beyondstop_sell) OVER (PARTITION BY v.product ORDER BY v.last_update) AS prev_beyondstop_sell,
        LAG(v.red_sell)        OVER (PARTITION BY v.product ORDER BY v.last_update) AS prev_red_sell,
        LAG(v.pink_sell)       OVER (PARTITION BY v.product ORDER BY v.last_update) AS prev_pink_sell,
        LAG(v.current_price)   OVER (PARTITION BY v.product ORDER BY v.last_update) AS prev_current_price
    FROM vw_122_zone_counts_by_update_pivoted2 AS v
),
events AS (
    SELECT
        b.*,
        CASE
            WHEN b.prev_red_buy  = 0 AND b.red_buy  > 0 and b.red_buy>b.red_sell*2 THEN 'SELL'
            WHEN b.prev_red_sell = 0 AND b.red_sell > 0 and b.red_sell > b.red_buy*2 THEN 'BUY'
            ELSE NULL
        END AS signal_one_col_raw,
        CASE
            WHEN b.red_sell > b.red_buy * 2 THEN 'buy'
            WHEN b.red_buy > b.red_sell * 2 THEN 'sell'
            ELSE NULL
        END AS signal_red_raw,
        CASE
            WHEN b.darkgreen_buy  > 0 AND b.darkgreen_sell = 0 THEN 'buy'
            WHEN b.darkgreen_sell > 0 AND b.darkgreen_buy  = 0 THEN 'sell'
            ELSE NULL
        END AS signal_darkgreen_raw
    FROM base AS b
),
marked AS (
    SELECT
        e.*,
        SUM(CASE WHEN e.signal_one_col_raw IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END)
          OVER (PARTITION BY e.product ORDER BY e.last_update
                ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS grp_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN e.signal_red_raw IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END)
          OVER (PARTITION BY e.product ORDER BY e.last_update
                ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS grp_id_red,
        SUM(CASE WHEN e.signal_darkgreen_raw IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END)
          OVER (PARTITION BY e.product ORDER BY e.last_update
                ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS grp_id_darkgreen
    FROM events AS e
)
SELECT
    product,
    last_update,

    /* current values */
   -- pink_buy,
	prev_darkgreen_buy,
   darkgreen_buy,
   green_buy,
    prev_red_buy,
    red_buy,
  --  beyondstop_buy,
    current_price,
  --  beyondstop_sell,
    prev_red_sell,
    red_sell,
   -- pink_sell,
   green_sell,
	prev_darkgreen_sell,
   darkgreen_sell,

    signal_combo,
    signal_beyondtarget,
    MAX(signal_darkgreen_raw) OVER (
        PARTITION BY product, grp_id_darkgreen
        ORDER BY last_update
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
    ) AS signal_darkgreen,
    signal_beyondstop,
    signal_final,

    /* previous values */
    --prev_pink_buy,
   -- prev_beyondstop_buy,
   -- prev_beyondstop_sell,
    --prev_pink_sell,
    prev_current_price,

    /* forward-filled BUY/SELL only; NULLs before the first event are preserved */
    MAX(signal_one_col_raw) OVER (
        PARTITION BY product, grp_id
        ORDER BY last_update
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
    ) AS signal_one_col,
    MAX(signal_red_raw) OVER (
        PARTITION BY product, grp_id_red
        ORDER BY last_update
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
    ) AS signal_red
FROM marked
ORDER BY last_update DESC;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW "vw_125_top5_netreturn_signal_counts" AS
WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        v.product,
        CASE
            WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(v.signal)), '') IS NULL THEN 'HOLD'
            WHEN UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(v.signal))) IN ('BUY','B')  THEN 'BUY'
            WHEN UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(v.signal))) IN ('SELL','S') THEN 'SELL'
            ELSE 'HOLD'
        END AS signal_bucket,
        v.net_return
    FROM vwCombined_trades_open AS v
    WHERE v.net_return IS NOT NULL
      AND v.product IS NOT NULL
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        b.product,
        b.signal_bucket,
        b.net_return,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY b.product
            ORDER BY b.net_return DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM base AS b
),
top5 AS (
    SELECT product, signal_bucket, net_return
    FROM ranked
    WHERE rn <= 5
)
SELECT
    t.product,
    -- counts
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.signal_bucket = 'BUY'  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)  AS buy_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.signal_bucket = 'SELL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)  AS sell_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.signal_bucket = 'HOLD' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)  AS hold_count,
    COUNT(*)                                                   AS total_in_top5,
    -- sum of net_return for those counts
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.signal_bucket = 'BUY'  THEN t.net_return ELSE 0 END)  AS buy_count_value,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.signal_bucket = 'SELL' THEN t.net_return ELSE 0 END)  AS sell_count_value
FROM top5 AS t
GROUP BY t.product;

name: vw_126_open_trades_counts_by_pos_alt

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW "vw_126_open_trades_counts_by_pos_alt" AS
WITH cfg AS (
    SELECT CAST(config_value AS INT) AS max_loss
    FROM config
    WHERE config_name = 'max_product_loss_count'
),
base AS (
    SELECT
        CAST(pos_alt_net_return AS int) AS pos_alt_net_return,
        product,
        UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(signal)))     AS signal
    FROM vw_113_Combined_trades_all AS v
),
products AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT product FROM base
),
signals AS (
    SELECT 'BUY' AS signal UNION ALL SELECT 'SELL'
),
grid AS (
    SELECT p.product, s.signal
    FROM products AS p
    CROSS JOIN signals  AS s
),
counts AS (
    SELECT pos_alt_net_return, product, signal, COUNT(*) AS trade_count
    FROM base
    GROUP BY pos_alt_net_return, product, signal
),
side0 AS (  -- losing side
    SELECT
        0 AS pos_alt_net_return,
        g.product,
        g.signal,
        COALESCE(c.trade_count, 0) AS trade_count
    FROM grid AS g
    LEFT JOIN counts AS c
      ON c.pos_alt_net_return = 0
     AND c.product            = g.product
     AND c.signal             = g.signal
    INNER JOIN cfg
      ON COALESCE(c.trade_count, 0) < cfg.max_loss
),
side1 AS (  -- profitable side
    SELECT
        1 AS pos_alt_net_return,
        g.product,
        g.signal,
        COALESCE(c.trade_count, 0) AS trade_count
    FROM grid AS g
    LEFT JOIN counts AS c
      ON c.pos_alt_net_return = 1
     AND c.product            = g.product
     AND c.signal             = g.signal
),
final AS (
    SELECT
        s0.pos_alt_net_return,
        s0.product,
        s0.signal,
        s0.trade_count,
        s1.pos_alt_net_return     AS pos_alt_net_return_2,
        s1.product                AS product_2,
        s1.signal                 AS signal_2,
        s1.trade_count            AS trade_count_2,
        CASE
            WHEN s0.trade_count = 0
                 THEN CAST(s1.trade_count AS FLOAT)
            ELSE CAST(s1.trade_count AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(s0.trade_count, 0)
        END AS trade_count_ratio
    FROM side0 AS s0
    JOIN side1 AS s1
      ON s1.product = s0.product
     AND s1.signal  = s0.signal
    WHERE s1.trade_count > 5
      AND (
            CASE
                WHEN s0.trade_count = 0
                     THEN CAST(s1.trade_count AS FLOAT)
                ELSE CAST(s1.trade_count AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(s0.trade_count, 0)
            END
          ) < (
            SELECT CAST(config_value AS FLOAT)
            FROM config
            WHERE config_name = 'min_trade_count_ratio'
          )
)
SELECT *
FROM final
ORDER BY trade_count_ratio ASC LIMIT 3;

    FROM vw_113_Combined_trades_all v
    CROSS JOIN cfg

product,

    COUNT(CASE WHEN r.trade_status = 'CLOSED' THEN 1 END) AS trade_count_closed,

    COUNT(CASE WHEN r.signal = 'SELL' and  r.trade_status = 'CLOSED' THEN 1 END) AS sell_count_closed,

--    SUM(CASE WHEN r.signal = 'SELL'  and  r.trade_status = 'open'  THEN r.pos_net_return     ELSE 0 END) AS pos_net_return_sell_open,

    SUM(CASE WHEN r.signal = 'BUY'  and  r.trade_status = 'CLOSED'    THEN r.pos_net_return     ELSE 0 END) AS pos_net_return_buy_closed,

--    SUM(CASE WHEN r.signal = 'SELL'  and  r.trade_status = 'open'   THEN r.pos_alt_net_return ELSE 0 END) AS pos_alt_net_return_sell_open,

    SUM(CASE WHEN r.signal = 'BUY'  and  r.trade_status = 'CLOSED'   THEN r.pos_alt_net_return ELSE 0 END) AS pos_alt_net_return_buy_closed,
    SUM(CASE WHEN r.signal = 'SELL'  and  r.trade_status = 'CLOSED'   THEN r.pos_alt_net_return ELSE 0 END) AS pos_alt_net_return_sell_closed

FROM recent r

group by product;

name: vw_200_zone_distribution_latest
sql:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW "vw_200_zone_distribution_latest" AS
WITH t AS (
    SELECT
        product,
        LOWER(signal) AS sig,
        UPPER(zone_name) AS zone_name
    FROM vwCombined_trades_open
    WHERE zone_name IS NOT NULL
),
latest_quotes AS (
    SELECT
        q.code,
        (q.bid + q.ask) / 2.0 AS latest_price,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY q.code ORDER BY q."timestamp" DESC) AS rn
    FROM vw_000_fx_quotes AS q
)
SELECT
    z.product,

    -- SELL: R9, R5..R1
    SUM(CASE WHEN z.sig='sell' AND z.zone_name='R9' THEN 1 END) AS s_R9,
    SUM(CASE WHEN z.sig='sell' AND z.zone_name='R5' THEN 1 END) AS s_R5,
    SUM(CASE WHEN z.sig='sell' AND z.zone_name='R4' THEN 1 END) AS s_R4,
    SUM(CASE WHEN z.sig='sell' AND z.zone_name='R3' THEN 1 END) AS s_R3,
    SUM(CASE WHEN z.sig='sell' AND z.zone_name='R2' THEN 1 END) AS s_R2,
    SUM(CASE WHEN z.sig='sell' AND z.zone_name='R1' THEN 1 END) AS s_R1,

    -- SELL: G1..G5, G9
    SUM(CASE WHEN z.sig='sell' AND z.zone_name='G1' THEN 1 END) AS s_G1,
    SUM(CASE WHEN z.sig='sell' AND z.zone_name='G2' THEN 1 END) AS s_G2,
    SUM(CASE WHEN z.sig='sell' AND z.zone_name='G3' THEN 1 END) AS s_G3,
    SUM(CASE WHEN z.sig='sell' AND z.zone_name='G4' THEN 1 END) AS s_G4,
    SUM(CASE WHEN z.sig='sell' AND z.zone_name='G5' THEN 1 END) AS s_G5,
    SUM(CASE WHEN z.sig='sell' AND z.zone_name='G9' THEN 1 END) AS s_G9,

    -- Current mid-price
    q.latest_price,

    -- BUY: R9, R5..R1
    SUM(CASE WHEN z.sig='buy'  AND z.zone_name='R9' THEN 1 END) AS b_R9,
    SUM(CASE WHEN z.sig='buy'  AND z.zone_name='R5' THEN 1 END) AS b_R5,
    SUM(CASE WHEN z.sig='buy'  AND z.zone_name='R4' THEN 1 END) AS b_R4,
    SUM(CASE WHEN z.sig='buy'  AND z.zone_name='R3' THEN 1 END) AS b_R3,
    SUM(CASE WHEN z.sig='buy'  AND z.zone_name='R2' THEN 1 END) AS b_R2,
    SUM(CASE WHEN z.sig='buy'  AND z.zone_name='R1' THEN 1 END) AS b_R1,

    -- BUY: G1..G5, G9
    SUM(CASE WHEN z.sig='buy'  AND z.zone_name='G1' THEN 1 END) AS b_G1,
    SUM(CASE WHEN z.sig='buy'  AND z.zone_name='G2' THEN 1 END) AS b_G2,
    SUM(CASE WHEN z.sig='buy'  AND z.zone_name='G3' THEN 1 END) AS b_G3,
    SUM(CASE WHEN z.sig='buy'  AND z.zone_name='G4' THEN 1 END) AS b_G4,
    SUM(CASE WHEN z.sig='buy'  AND z.zone_name='G5' THEN 1 END) AS b_G5,
    SUM(CASE WHEN z.sig='buy'  AND z.zone_name='G9' THEN 1 END) AS b_G9

FROM t AS z
LEFT JOIN latest_quotes AS q
    ON q.code = z.product AND q.rn = 1
GROUP BY
    z.product, q.latest_price;

        LAG(b_G5) OVER (PARTITION BY product ORDER BY snapshot_time) AS prev_b_G5,
        LAG(b_G4) OVER (PARTITION BY product ORDER BY snapshot_time) AS prev_b_G4,
        LAG(b_G3) OVER (PARTITION BY product ORDER BY snapshot_time) AS prev_b_G3,

    product,
    s_G9, s_G5, s_G4, s_G3, s_G2, s_G1,
    latest_price,
    b_G1, b_G2, b_G3, b_G4, b_G5, b_G9,

    CASE WHEN prev_s_G9 > 0 AND s_G9 IS NULL THEN 'BUY' END AS sg9,
    CASE WHEN prev_s_G5 > 0 AND s_G5 IS NULL THEN 'BUY' END AS sg5,
    CASE WHEN prev_s_G4 > 0 AND s_G4 IS NULL THEN 'BUY' END AS sg4,
    CASE WHEN prev_s_G3 > 0 AND s_G3 IS NULL THEN 'BUY' END AS sg3,
    CASE WHEN prev_s_G2 > 0 AND s_G2 IS NULL THEN 'BUY' END AS sg2,

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW "vw_210_breach_next_same_signal" AS
WITH cfg AS (
    SELECT 
        tsql_compat.try_convert_float(config_value) AS breach_min_target_profit
    FROM config
    WHERE config_name = 'breach_min_target_profit'
),
breaches AS (
    SELECT
        c.trade_status AS breach_trade_status,
        c.guid         AS breach_guid,
        c.product,
        c.model,
        c.signal,
        c.created,
        c.last_update,
        c.alt_net_return,
        c.target_profit,
        c.target_loss
    FROM vw_113_Combined_trades_all c
    CROSS JOIN cfg
    WHERE c.trade_status = 'CLOSED'                    -- only closed trades as breaches
      AND c.alt_net_return < (c.target_profit * -1)    -- big loss
      AND c.target_profit >
          COALESCE(cfg.breach_min_target_profit, 300)    -- threshold from config, default 300
      -- AND c.model LIKE '%DNA%'                      -- optional filter
)
SELECT
    b.product,
    b.model,
    b.signal,

    -- breach trade
    b.breach_trade_status,
    b.breach_guid       AS breach_guid,
    b.created           AS breach_created,
    b.last_update       AS breach_last_update,
    b.alt_net_return    AS breach_alt_net_return,
    b.target_profit     AS breach_target_profit,
    b.target_loss       AS breach_target_loss,

    -- next trade with same model+signal after breach.last_update
    n.trade_status      AS next_trade_status,
    n.guid              AS next_guid,
    n.created           AS next_created,
    n.last_update       AS next_last_update,
    n.alt_net_return    AS next_alt_net_return,
    n.target_profit     AS next_target_profit
FROM breaches b
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT c2.*
    FROM vw_113_Combined_trades_all c2
    WHERE c2.model  = b.model
      AND c2.signal = b.signal
      AND c2.created > b.last_update
    ORDER BY c2.created ASC
) n LIMIT 1;

        signal,
        net_return
    FROM vwCombined_trades_closed
    WHERE created >= tsql_compat.dateadd(HOUR, -2, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)  -- last 2 hours
),
agg AS (
    SELECT
        product,
        signal,
        COUNT(*) AS closed_count_by_product_signal,
        SUM(CASE WHEN net_return > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_closed_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN net_return > 0 THEN net_return ELSE 0 END) AS positive_net_return_sum
    FROM src
    GROUP BY product, signal
)
SELECT
    a.product,
    a.signal,

    -- count of closed by product (all signals)
    SUM(a.closed_count_by_product_signal) OVER (PARTITION BY a.product) AS closed_count_by_product,

    -- count of positive closes by product, signal
    a.positive_closed_count,

    -- positives as % of total by product, signal
    CASE 
        WHEN a.closed_count_by_product_signal = 0 THEN 0
        ELSE CAST(a.positive_closed_count * 100.0 
                  / a.closed_count_by_product_signal AS decimal(5,2))
    END AS positives_pct_of_total_by_product_signal,

    -- net_return value of positive close by product, signal
    a.positive_net_return_sum AS net_return_positive_sum_by_product_signal

FROM agg AS a;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW "vw_700_GreedyBuckets" AS
WITH Base AS (
    SELECT
        t.model,
        t.product,
        t.signal,
        -- derive entry_bucket + time_bin
        CAST(FLOOR(t.entry_price * 1000) AS int) AS entry_bucket,
        CAST(tsql_compat.datediff(MINUTE, '2000-01-01', t.created) / 5 AS int) AS time_bin,
        t.net_return_sum,
        t.alt_net_return_sum
    FROM vw_113_Combined_trades_all AS t
)
, NetBranch AS (
    SELECT
        model, product, signal, entry_bucket, time_bin,
        CAST('net_return' AS nvarchar(20)) AS return_type,
        COUNT(*) AS trade_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN net_return_sum > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS win_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN net_return_sum <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS loss_count,
        SUM(net_return_sum) AS return_sum,
        AVG(CAST(net_return_sum AS float)) AS avg_return,
        CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN net_return_sum > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS float) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS hit_rate
    FROM Base
    GROUP BY model, product, signal, entry_bucket, time_bin
)
, AltBranch AS (
    SELECT
        model, product, signal, entry_bucket, time_bin,
        CAST('alt_net_return' AS nvarchar(20)) AS return_type,
        COUNT(*) AS trade_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN alt_net_return_sum > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS win_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN alt_net_return_sum <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS loss_count,
        SUM(alt_net_return_sum) AS return_sum,
        AVG(CAST(alt_net_return_sum AS float)) AS avg_return,
        CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN alt_net_return_sum > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS float) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS hit_rate
    FROM Base
    GROUP BY model, product, signal, entry_bucket, time_bin
)
SELECT * FROM NetBranch
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM AltBranch;

   -- UPDATE config SET config_value='gbp'                    WHERE config_name='tbl_model_signal_net_product';

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW "vw_700_tbl_model_signal_net_diff" AS
WITH cutoff AS (
    SELECT TRY_CAST(config_value AS datetime2(3)) AS since_dt
    FROM config 
    WHERE config_name = 'tbl_model_signal_net_since'
),
base AS (
    SELECT msn.*
    FROM tbl_model_signal_net AS msn
    CROSS JOIN (
        SELECT
            COALESCE( (SELECT since_dt FROM cutoff),
                    tsql_compat.dateadd(DAY, -7, SYSUTCDATETIME()) ) AS since_dt,
            COALESCE( (SELECT config_value
                     FROM config 
                     WHERE config_name = 'tbl_model_signal_net_product'),
                    N'gbp') AS product_filter
    ) c
    WHERE msn.update_time >= c.since_dt
      AND msn.product     = c.product_filter
),
first_time AS (
    SELECT product, model, signal, MIN(update_time) AS first_update_time
    FROM base
    GROUP BY product, model, signal
),
first_vals AS (
    SELECT b.product, b.model, b.signal,
           b.update_time,
           b.net_return_sum        AS base_net_return_sum,
           b.alt_net_return_sum    AS base_alt_net_return_sum
    FROM base b
    JOIN first_time ft
      ON ft.product = b.product
     AND ft.model   = b.model
     AND ft.signal  = b.signal
     AND ft.first_update_time = b.update_time
)
SELECT
    b.update_time,
    b.product,
    b.model,
    b.signal,
    (b.net_return_sum     - fv.base_net_return_sum)     AS net_return_diff,
    (b.alt_net_return_sum - fv.base_alt_net_return_sum) AS alt_net_return_diff,
    b.net_return_sum,
    b.alt_net_return_sum,
    fv.base_net_return_sum,
    fv.base_alt_net_return_sum,
    CASE WHEN b.update_time = fv.update_time THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_baseline
FROM base b
JOIN first_vals fv
  ON fv.product = b.product
 AND fv.model   = b.model
 AND fv.signal  = b.signal;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW "vw_800_hybrid_controls" AS
WITH latest AS
(
    SELECT
        rs.regime_id,
        rs.product,
        rs.model,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY rs.product, rs.model ORDER BY rs.evaluated_at DESC) AS rn
    FROM tbl_800_regime_state rs
)
SELECT
    rs.product,
    rs.model,
    rs.product_type,
    rs.regime_state,
    rs.fast_side,
    rs.slow_side,
    rs.metrics_id,
    m.window_end,
    m.buy_trade_count,
    m.sell_trade_count,
    m.buy_avg_duration_minutes,
    m.sell_avg_duration_minutes,
    m.dur_ratio,
    m.count_ratio,
    CASE
        WHEN rs.regime_state LIKE 'TREND_%'
             AND fn_800_fast_exposure_safe(rs.product, rs.model, rs.fast_side) = 1 THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END AS can_stuff,
    CASE
        WHEN rs.regime_state LIKE 'TREND_%'
             AND (
                    (rs.fast_side = 'BUY'  AND m.sell_avg_duration_minutes >= cfg.slow_duration_threshold)
                 OR (rs.fast_side = 'SELL' AND m.buy_avg_duration_minutes  >= cfg.slow_duration_threshold)
                 ) THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END AS must_ghost,
    CASE WHEN rs.regime_state = 'TRANSITION' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS transition_active,
    CASE
        WHEN rs.regime_state LIKE 'TREND_%' AND COALESCE(m.dur_ratio, 0) >= cfg.breakdown_ratio THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END AS auto_flip_armed
FROM latest l
JOIN tbl_800_regime_state rs ON l.regime_id = rs.regime_id AND l.rn = 1
JOIN tbl_800_trade_metrics m ON rs.metrics_id = m.metrics_id
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
        COALESCE( AS "slow_duration_threshold"
            tsql_compat.try_convert_numeric((SELECT config_value FROM config  WHERE config_name = 'hybrid_slow_duration_threshold')),
            25.0
        ),
        COALESCE( AS "breakdown_ratio"
            tsql_compat.try_convert_numeric((SELECT TOP (1) config_value FROM config  WHERE config_name = 'hybrid_fast_breakdown_ratio')),
            1.50
        )
) cfg LIMIT 1;

        WHEN o.net_return >= 0 AND o.net_return < o.target_profit * 0.2 THEN 'G1'
        WHEN o.net_return >= o.target_profit * 0.2 AND o.net_return < o.target_profit * 0.4 THEN 'G2'
        WHEN o.net_return >= o.target_profit * 0.4 AND o.net_return < o.target_profit * 0.6 THEN 'G3'
        WHEN o.net_return >= o.target_profit * 0.6 AND o.net_return < o.target_profit * 0.8 THEN 'G4'
        WHEN o.net_return >= o.target_profit * 0.8 AND o.net_return <= o.target_profit THEN 'G5'
        -- Loss Zones (R1-R5) - Note: target_loss is negative, so multiplication by 0.x makes it less negative (closest to 0)
        WHEN o.net_return < 0 AND o.net_return >= o.target_loss * 0.8 THEN 'R1' -- Smallest loss (e.g., -80 to 0 for target_loss -100)
        WHEN o.net_return < o.target_loss * 0.6 AND o.net_return >= o.target_loss * 0.4 THEN 'R2' -- e.g., -60 to -40
        WHEN o.net_return < o.target_loss * 0.4 AND o.net_return >= o.target_loss * 0.2 THEN 'R3' -- e.g., -40 to -20
        WHEN o.net_return < o.target_loss * 0.2 AND o.net_return >= o.target_loss THEN 'R4' -- e.g., -20 to -100
        WHEN o.net_return < o.target_loss * 0.8 AND o.net_return >= o.target_loss * 0.6 THEN 'R5' -- e.g., -100 to -80
        ELSE 'Unknown'
      END,
    zone_rank =
      CASE
        -- 2025-10-27: New numerical ranks for zone categorization
        WHEN o.net_return IS NULL OR o.target_profit IS NULL OR o.target_loss IS NULL THEN -1
        WHEN o.net_return < o.target_loss THEN 0 -- R9
        WHEN o.net_return > o.target_profit THEN 11 -- G9
        -- Profit Ranks (G1-G5)
        WHEN o.net_return >= 0 AND o.net_return < o.target_profit * 0.2 THEN 6 -- G1
        WHEN o.net_return >= o.target_profit * 0.2 AND o.net_return < o.target_profit * 0.4 THEN 7 -- G2
        WHEN o.net_return >= o.target_profit * 0.4 AND o.net_return < o.target_profit * 0.6 THEN 8 -- G3
        WHEN o.net_return >= o.target_profit * 0.6 AND o.net_return < o.target_profit * 0.8 THEN 9 -- G4
        WHEN o.net_return >= o.target_profit * 0.8 AND o.net_return <= o.target_profit THEN 10 -- G5
        -- Loss Ranks (R1-R5) - Note: target_loss is negative
        WHEN o.net_return < 0 AND o.net_return >= o.target_loss * 0.8 THEN 5 -- R1
        WHEN o.net_return < o.target_loss * 0.6 AND o.net_return >= o.target_loss * 0.4 THEN 4 -- R2
        WHEN o.net_return < o.target_loss * 0.4 AND o.net_return >= o.target_loss * 0.2 THEN 3 -- R3
        WHEN o.net_return < o.target_loss * 0.2 AND o.net_return >= o.target_loss THEN 2 -- R4
        WHEN o.net_return < o.target_loss * 0.8 AND o.net_return >= o.target_loss * 0.6 THEN 1 -- R5
        ELSE -1
      END,
	  o.g_close_time,
	  o.g_net_return,
	  o.g_alt_net_return
  FROM combined_trades_open AS o
),
red_seq AS (
  SELECT
    b.guid,
    CASE
      WHEN b.zone_name = 'Red' AND b.signal = 'buy'
      THEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.product ORDER BY b.last_update, b.guid)
    END AS red_buy,
    CASE
      WHEN b.zone_name = 'Red' AND b.signal = 'sell'
      THEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b.product ORDER BY b.last_update, b.guid)
    END AS red_sell
  FROM base AS b
)
SELECT
  b.*,
  rs.red_buy,
  rs.red_sell
FROM base AS b
LEFT JOIN red_seq AS rs
  ON rs.guid = b.guid
CROSS JOIN cfg
WHERE
  b.created >= cfg.today_start
  AND b.created <  cfg.tomorrow_start
  AND b.created >= tsql_compat.dateadd(SECOND, -cfg.expire_seconds, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) LIMIT 1;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW "vwCombined_trades_output" AS
SELECT
    guid,
    model,
    product,
    created,
    net_return,
    alt_net_return,

    /* ===== DAILY CUMULATIVE METRICS BY MODEL ===== */
    SUM(net_return) OVER (
        PARTITION BY model, CAST(created AS date)
        ORDER BY created, guid
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS net_return_sum,

    SUM(alt_net_return) OVER (
        PARTITION BY model, CAST(created AS date)
        ORDER BY created, guid
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS alt_net_return_sum,

    COUNT(1) OVER (
        PARTITION BY model, CAST(created AS date)
        ORDER BY created, guid
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS trade_count

FROM combined_trades_open
WHERE model LIKE 'DNA%';
